# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** College Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella Maynard is a very beautiful girl with vivid black eyes. In her second year at Redmond Academy, she carried off the palm for beauty alongside Anne Shirley.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella possesses a heart full of wistful, aerial, and rainbow-like dreams and fancies. Though she has moments of discouragement where she feels doleful, she is bright, sympathetic, and enjoys spending pleasant hours with her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Prone to occasional discouragement

## Abilities

- Academic aptitude  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- Pursuing her college education at Redmond  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Redmond College as a classmate and intimate friend of Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. During her second year, she was recognized as one of the prettiest girls of her class. She shared many pleasant hours, conversations, and study sessions with Anne and her circle of friends, often bonding over their shared ambitions and imaginative outlooks.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Affiliations

- Redmond College — Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
